scope: Proposition 8.3 of the manuscript “An explicit counterexample to the Auslander-Reiten conjecture” (preprints/An-explicit-counterexample-to-the-Auslander-Reiten-conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 199 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 22f6a9d5151fca3a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 25. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The finite bimodule F in (8.3) is projective on both A-sides, and the map v of Lemma 8.1 satisfies the following conditions. For every integer a ≥ 0, define δa : Ha ⊕ Ha −→ V a , (g, j) 7−→ F(g)v + v[a]j. (8.6) Then δ0 is surjective with a one-dimensional kernel, and δa is an isomorphism for every integer a > 0.
